content: Panger llulupal temarong ngo Deus yema duwler ngo ye hatugulur bo rebe yengang ngali bo yagilir yarmat cholop, le rebe ma fang kafang mo maligach bo hachuchuyel molfid.
Iy mwo ngo ye cholop mekla ye tayikel iyang. Ila fal le yela yoh ngali le yebe malulu ngalir rechoka rema toa machey luwul yar temedaf.
Iwe ngo fael mala iy mwo ngo ye tayikel mele yema fang maligach le te hachuchuyel chog molfider yarmat bo wol hachuchuyel molfidel iy llufulyal.
Tor semal le yema iy chog llufulyal ngo yesa foru bo iy llulupal temarong. Bo fofos la chog yael Deus mele yebe yoh le semal be mel bo llulupal temarong iyang le be wochog Aaron.
Iye sengal chog Kristus, bo te iy chog mele ye duwley sala yoh le yebe mel bo llulupal temarong. Deus ye far kangalu bo,

content.text: igla mele isa mel bo Tamom.”

content: Ngo ye wol sor mo solbos bo,

content.text: “Hobe mel bo temarong le towe yor siyal,
le hobe wochog temarong we Melchizedek.”

content: Yodwe ye chil mel Jesus wol talop le ngo yema tetawul, ngo ye tetang luwul yal memapel, mo dodongor ngal Deus le iy mele yebe yoh le yebe hadora mo irel maes. Yal luglug mo yal hatetalo mele Deus yela taelenga mapel kowe yal iyang.
Ila mwo iy Lol Deus ngo luwul yal hafohoy mele yela gola le yebe hasrowu yalol Deus.
Yela hamallo pangal formel ngo yesa mel bo iy mele chapil molow la tor siyal ngalir rechoka re taelenga yalol.
Iwe ngo Deus yesa sor bo yebe mel bo iy llulupal temarong le be wochog yael Melchizedek mel bo llulupal temarong.
Ye cholop mele sibe sor irel mele ngo halachog ila ye weres le sibe hamdefa ngalugmi bo ha tema ttiril medaf.

Yesa luyloh yodla habe sensey iyang, ngo hami ha chil yetedah chog dipmi wol semal le be hamdefa ngalugmi mokwe ye hartael mechrag, mo irel mokwe yalol Deus. Ha chil wochog yalwich kowe re ted ma mongoy, mongoy ka ye remmasow bo melik chog mele rema yul.
Semal le ye chil ma yyulul melik, ila ye chil yalwich ngo ye ted gola meka ye bung mo ika ye tabung.
Mongoy ka ye masow ila haler cholellap, rechoka resa repiy le rema luluwal malulu iwe ngo re sala gola lligamdefal momay mo taiykof.
